remarks: Nestled in the coveted Forest Creek Estates, this expansive two-story Colonial delivers flexibility with bonus indoor and outdoor living spaces. Perched on over a half-acre of serene wooded surroundings, this captivating estate offers sweeping nature views of a protected forest and creek sanctuary, ultimate privacy, and minimal backyard maintenance. Boasting 4,400+ sq. ft. of total living space (3,100+ above grade, 1,300+ lower), this custom 4-bed, 2.5-bath home offers quality craftsmanship and extensive updates. A dramatic two-story foyer with marble flooring instantly impresses. The spacious living room has hardwood floors, cathedral ceilings, rich woodwork, and a cozy wood-burning fireplace. The beautifully designed kitchen features a center island, abundant cabinetry, hardwoods, walk-in pantries, efficient lighting and newer stainless appliances, plus doors opening to nature. Showcasing a 10-foot ceiling, crown molding, and hardwoods, the formal dining room provides a fine compliment. A highly desirable first-floor primary suite features cathedral ceilings, a glamour bath with whirlpool tub, and a walk-in closet. French doors open to a versatile office, playroom, or studio. The second floor offers a full bath with jetted tub and three bedrooms with modern ceiling fans. The redesigned lower level adds 1,300+ sq. ft. of flexible living and entertaining spaces with two bonus rooms, game nook, new Berber carpet, and efficient lighting, opening to a private patio and hillside views. Upgrades include: new roof, French drains, high-efficiency Lennox HVAC and smart thermostat, hot water tank, 200-amp service, added exterior outlets and garage electric, fresh paint, new carpets, energy-efficient lighting, fixtures, ceiling fans, faucets, toilets, extensive tree removal, garage door and opener. A restored front balcony with vinyl railings, multi-level refreshed decking, and revitalized grounds enhance the home’s appeal and outdoor enjoyment year round. Prime location in close proximity to River Oaks Golf Club and Marina.
